segs.en: D. Energetic Cook

zh.ai: D. 精力充沛的厨师

segs.en: Monocarp the Cook works in a large restaurant. He can cook two types of dishes: soup and dumplings. He likes to cook soup more — he spends one unit of energy to cook a soup serving and two units of energy to cook a dumpling serving. Soup and dumplings have different shelf life times:

zh.ai: 厨师 Monocarp 在一家大型餐厅工作。他会烹饪两种菜肴：汤和饺子。他更喜欢烹饪汤，因为烹饪一份汤需要消耗一个单位的能量，而烹饪一份饺子需要消耗两个单位的能量。汤和饺子的保质期不同：

segs.en: a soup serving must be consumed either on the same day it is cooked or on the next day;

zh.ai: 一份汤必须在烹制当天或次日食用；

segs.en: a dumpling serving can be stored for an infinite amount of days, so it can be consumed on any day, starting from the day it is cooked.

zh.ai: 一份饺子可以无限期储存，因此从烹饪当天开始，它可以在任意一天食用。

segs.en: The restaurant is open for $$$n$$$ consecutive days. During the $$$i$$$-th day, there will be $$$a_i$$$ visitors in the restaurant. Monocarp should give either a serving of soup or a serving of dumplings to each visitor. Monocarp can serve any dish at his discretion. He can also serve different dish types during the day. The only requirement is that the dish's shelf life must be within allowed limits:

zh.ai: 这家餐厅将连续营业 $$$n$$$ 天。在第 $$$i$$$ 天，餐厅将有 $$$a_i$$$ 位顾客。Monocarp 应为每位顾客提供一份汤或一份饺子。Monocarp 可以自行决定提供哪种菜肴，也可以在一天内提供不同种类的菜肴。唯一的要求是，菜肴的保质期必须在允许范围内：

segs.en: if a soup serving is given on day $$$1$$$, it must have been cooked on the same day;

zh.ai: 如果一份汤在第 $$$1$$$ 天供应，那么它必须在当天烹饪；

segs.en: if a soup serving is given on day $$$i  \gt  1$$$, it must have been cooked on day $$$i - 1$$$ or on day $$$i$$$;

zh.ai: 如果一份汤在第 $$$i  \gt  1$$$ 天供应，那么它必须是在第 $$$i - 1$$$ 天或第 $$$i$$$ 天烹制的；

segs.en: if a dumpling serving is given on day $$$i$$$, it may have been cooked on any day between $$$1$$$ and $$$i$$$ inclusive.

zh.ai: 如果一份在第 $$$i$$$ 天供应的饺子，它可能是在第 $$$1$$$ 天至第 $$$i$$$ 天(含首尾)之间的任意一天烹制的。

segs.en: Every day Monocarp starts with the same amount of energy $$$E$$$ — that is, he can cook any amount of soup and dumplings as long as the total energy he spends during each day is not greater than $$$E$$$. It is impossible to "conserve" energy — for example, if $$$E = 1$$$, Monocarp cannot choose to do nothing on one day and cook a serving of dumplings on the next day.

zh.ai: 每天 Monocarp 都以相同的能量 $$$E$$$ 开始一天——也就是说，只要他每天消耗的总能量不超过 $$$E$$$，他就可以烹饪任意数量的汤和饺子。能量无法“储存”——例如，如果 $$$E = 1$$$，Monocarp 不能选择某一天什么都不做，然后在第二天烹饪一份饺子。

segs.en: Monocarp would like to know the minimum possible amount of energy $$$E$$$ which he needs to have at the beginning of every day (same for each day) that would be enough to feed all visitors if he cooks dishes optimally.

zh.ai: Monocarp 想知道，每天开始时他至少需要拥有多少能量 $$$E$$$(每天相同)，才能在最优烹饪菜肴的情况下为所有访客提供食物。

segs.en: The first line of the input contains one integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the number of consecutive days the restaurant is open.

zh.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$($$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$)，表示餐厅连续营业的天数。

segs.en: The second line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$ ($$$0 \le a_i \le 10^9$$$), where $$$a_i$$$ is the number of visitors during the $$$i$$$-th day.

zh.ai: 第二行包含 $$$n$$$ 个整数 $$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$($$$0 \le a_i \le 10^9$$$)，其中 $$$a_i$$$ 表示第 $$$i$$$ 天的访客数量。

segs.en: Print one integer — the minimum amount of energy Monocarp needs to be able to cook enough dishes for all visitors.

zh.ai: 输出一个整数——Monocarp 为能够为所有访客烹饪足够的菜肴所需的最少能量。

segs.en: E. Tournament

zh.ai: E. 锦标赛

segs.en: In a distant galaxy, a space football tournament is being held. All $$$2^n$$$ national teams of star systems take part in the competition. The draw has already been made, and the tournament bracket is known: team $$$1$$$ will play against team $$$2$$$, team $$$3$$$ — against team $$$4$$$, and so on. Then the losing teams are eliminated and the winning teams play against each other until all teams but one are eliminated. Each time, pairs are formed from the sequence of winners of the previous round, sorted by their indices in increasing order. In particular, the winner of the game between team $$$1$$$ and team $$$2$$$ faces the winner of the game between team $$$3$$$ and team $$$4$$$, the winner of the game between team $$$5$$$ and team $$$6$$$ faces the winner of the game between team $$$7$$$ and team $$$8$$$, and so on.

zh.ai: 在遥远的星系中，一场太空足球锦标赛正在举行。所有 $$$2^n$$$ 支国家队都参加了比赛。抽签已经完成，比赛赛程也已确定：队伍 $$$1$$$ 将与队伍 $$$2$$$ 对阵，队伍 $$$3$$$ 将与队伍 $$$4$$$ 对阵，依此类推。随后，落败的队伍被淘汰，获胜的队伍继续相互对阵，直到除一支队伍外的所有队伍都被淘汰。每一轮比赛中，参赛队伍都由上一轮的获胜队伍按编号递增排序后，依次两两配对组成。特别地，队伍 $$$1$$$ 与队伍 $$$2$$$ 比赛的获胜者将对阵队伍 $$$3$$$ 与队伍 $$$4$$$ 比赛的获胜者，队伍 $$$5$$$ 与队伍 $$$6$$$ 比赛的获胜者将对阵队伍 $$$7$$$ 与队伍 $$$8$$$ 比赛的获胜者，依此类推。

segs.en: Each team is characterized by two values: a game experience value $$$g_i$$$ and a media rating value $$$m_i$$$. The values of $$$g_i$$$ of all teams are pairwise distinct. In every match, the team with the higher experience defeats the team with the lower experience — that is, of course, unless the referee interferes.

zh.ai: 每支队伍由两个值描述：比赛经验值 $$$g_i$$$ 和媒体评分值 $$$m_i$$$。所有队伍的 $$$g_i$$$ 值两两不同。在每场比赛中，经验值更高的队伍会击败经验值更低的队伍——当然，除非裁判进行干预。

segs.en: The tournament organizers want to sell the rights to broadcast it on TV. However, the TV companies want the tournament to be as media-friendly as possible. The total media rating is calculated as the sum of the ratings of the participants of each game. In other words, if a team plays several games, its media rating is counted the same number of times in the total media rating.

zh.ai: 锦标赛组织者希望出售其电视转播权。然而，电视公司希望锦标赛尽可能具有媒体吸引力。总媒体评分定义为每场比赛中参赛队伍评分之和。换言之，如果一支队伍参加了多场比赛，那么它的媒体评分会在总媒体评分中被重复计算相应次数。

segs.en: The organizers cannot change the structure of the tournament. However, they know that if the referee is given a "bonus" of $$$d$$$ space dollars, then the referee will "increase" the game experience of the weaker team in the pair by exactly $$$d$$$ units. If the game experience of the weaker team becomes strictly greater than the game experience of the stronger team, then the weaker team wins. Otherwise, the stronger team wins. Note that the game experience of the winning team resets after the match.

zh.ai: 组织者无法改变锦标赛的结构。然而，他们知道，如果给裁判 $$$d$$$ 太空美元的“奖金”，裁判就会恰好将该对阵中较弱队伍的比赛经验“增加” $$$d$$$ 单位。如果较弱队伍的比赛经验变得严格大于较强队伍的比赛经验，则较弱队伍获胜。否则，较强队伍获胜。注意，获胜队伍的比赛经验会在比赛后重置。

segs.en: The organizers decided to give the referee of each match the same bonus (of course, this bonus should be a non-negative integer amount of space dollars). Your task is to determine the minimum possible bonus that maximizes the total media rating of the tournament.

zh.ai: 组织者决定为每场比赛的裁判发放相同的奖金（当然，这笔奖金应为非负整数个太空币）。你的任务是确定能够使比赛总媒体评分最大化的最小奖金。

segs.en: The first line contains one integer $$$n$$$ ($$$2 \le n \le 8$$$).

zh.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$($$$2 \le n \le 8$$$)。

segs.en: The second line contains $$$2^n$$$ integers $$$g_1, g_2, \dots, g_{2^n}$$$ ($$$1 \le g_i \le 10^9$$$) — the game experience values of the teams. All values of $$$g_i$$$ are pairwise distinct.

zh.ai: 第二行包含 $$$2^n$$$ 个整数 $$$g_1, g_2, \dots, g_{2^n}$$$ ($$$1 \le g_i \le 10^9$$$) —— 各队伍的游戏经验值。 $$$g_i$$$ 中的所有值两两不同。

segs.en: The third line contains $$$2^n$$$ integers $$$m_1, m_2, \dots, m_{2^n}$$$ ($$$1 \le m_i \le 10^9$$$) — the media rating values of the teams.

zh.ai: 第三行包含 $$$2^n$$$ 个整数 $$$m_1, m_2, \dots, m_{2^n}$$$($$$1 \le m_i \le 10^9$$$)——各队的媒体评分值。

segs.en: Print two integers — the maximum possible total media rating of the tournament and the minimum possible bonus that allows obtaining this rating.

zh.ai: 输出两个整数：比赛可能达到的最大媒体评分总和，以及能够获得该评分的最小奖金。
